result.work_basis: The source rate is an optimistic committed-output roofline bound expanded to the pinned deployment timing scope. A throughput haircut is applied once to source peak output. Work-bound weights convert output capacity to peak billable-token capacity. Useful load and availability are applied once, only when converting peak billable capacity to delivered billable capacity. The required throughput hurdle is delivered throughput and is never pre-adjusted by load or availability. Provider values are public token-price surfaces only, not performance baselines. Region labels describe only the configured modeled sweep and do not establish business viability or provider superiority.

claims.robustness_scope: Configured modeled sensitivity sweep only; region labels do not establish business viability or provider superiority.
